title: Thousand Island Dressing
summary: Shop mayonnaise whisked with ketchup, sweet pickle relish, red onion, cider vinegar and paprika.

ingredients.item: sweet pickle relish or finely chopped sweet gherkins

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Chop the onion and pickles as finely as you can so they spread evenly.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, ketchup, relish, onion, vinegar, paprika and pepper until smooth and evenly pink.

steps.title: Taste
steps.text: Add a few more drops of vinegar if you like it sharper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over iceberg lettuce wedges, or use in burgers and sandwiches.

tips: Rinse the chopped onion in cold water for a milder taste.
Chill 30 min so the flavours blend.
Thin with 1 tsp water if you want a pourable dressing.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
